title: Slimebois
description: A Create Aeronautics modpack — build flying ships, automate everything, and explore with friends on NeoForge 1.21.1.
body:
# Slimebois

A modpack built around **Create Aeronautics** — engineer flying ships, automate your base, and explore together on NeoForge 1.21.1.

## Mods

**Core**
- [Create 6.0](https://modrinth.com/mod/create) — the engineering backbone
- [Create Aeronautics](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-aeronautics) — build and pilot flying ships
- [Sable](https://modrinth.com/mod/sable) — physics engine for Aeronautics
- [Sophisticated Backpacks](https://modrinth.com/mod/sophisticated-backpacks) — organised inventory on the go

**Create add-ons**
- [Create: New Age](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-new-age) — electricity and generators
- [Create: Enchantment Industry](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-enchantment-industry) — automate enchanting with liquid XP
- [Create: Dragons Plus](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-dragons-plus) — dragon-powered Create machinery
- [Create: Connected](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-connected) — seamless connected textures

**Quality of life**
- [Jade](https://modrinth.com/mod/jade) — block and machine tooltips
- [EMI](https://modrinth.com/mod/emi) — recipe viewer

**Performance & visuals**
- [Embeddium](https://modrinth.com/mod/embeddium) — major FPS boost
- [FerriteCore](https://modrinth.com/mod/ferrite-core) — reduced memory usage
- [ModernFix](https://modrinth.com/mod/modernfix) — faster startup
- [Distant Horizons](https://modrinth.com/mod/distanthorizons) — extended render distance with LOD

## How to play

1. Install the [Modrinth App](https://modrinth.com/app)
2. Search **slimebois** and click Install
3. Hit Play and connect to the server in Multiplayer
